우물: Wikimedia Pageviews REST API — en.wikipedia, agent=user, monthly, 2025-09 ~ 2026-08. Fetched twice per act: access=desktop and access=all-access.
Phone is all-access minus desktop, so it is mobile web and the Wikipedia app added together. We do not report the app separately.
Debut years joined from kcw-generation.json (Wikidata P571). Acts without one are kept but not binned.
이것이무엇인가: Which device people used when they looked up a Korean act on English Wikipedia.
이것이아닌것: 🔴 It is not age. Wikimedia publishes no reader age, and this page makes no claim about how old anybody is. A phone is not young and a desktop is not middle-aged.
It is not location. Device and country are separate measurements; ours is device only.
It is not our own site. Our visitors are measured separately in GA4; this is reading on Wikipedia.
Acts read under 1000 times in the window are dropped rather than shown with a noisy share.

선.전화의뜻: all-access minus desktop — mobile web plus the app
선.띠: Ten-year bands by founding year. Acts with no recorded year are counted in the totals but not in the bands.
